versions.name: Mount Carroll Cabin
versions.address: 18682 Indian Trail Rd, Mt. Carroll, IL 61053
versions.summary: A rustic Blackhawk Area Council cabin on wooded acreage north of Mount Carroll, Illinois, with wooden bunks, a wood-burning stove, and a fireplace, available to units for weekend camping without electricity or indoor plumbing.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council and operating status re-verified from the Blackhawk Area Council property page, which also supplied the precise street address (the source hint gave only a town). Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council property page; classified conservatively as a short-term (weekend cabin) camp; features unsurveyed.
